header.running_head: The Hospitality and service that the Ansaar Rendered

blocks.text: The Hospitality and service that the Ansaar Rendered
The Hospitality of the Ansaar and the Story of Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA)

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA) once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ who had just finished distributing food. Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA) mentioned to Rasulullaah ﷺ that a family of the Ansaar from the Banu Zafar tribe were very needy. He also added that most of the members of that family were women. Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "O Usayd! You left us (without saying anything) until everything has left our hands. However, if you hear that we receive anything, do remind me of that family." A while later, some barley and dates came to Rasulullaah ﷺ from Khaybar. Rasulullaah ﷺ then distributed it amongst the Muslims and especially gave a large amount to the Ansaar and to that particular family.
Expressing his gratitude, Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA) said, "May Allaah grant you the most sublime rewards, O Nabi of Allaah ﷺ." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "In fact, may Allaah grant the most sublime rewards to you, O assembly of Ansaar. As far as I know, you have always been most chaste and most patient. However, after I die, you shall soon see that others will be given preference over you in leadership and in distribution of wealth. I urge you to be patient until you meet me at the pond (of Kowthar)." [^1]

Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA) narrates that two families approached him requesting that he ask Rasulullaah ﷺ to include them in the distribution of food or to give them something from it. The one family was from the Banu Zafar tribe while the other was from the Banu Mu'aawiya tribe. When he spoke to Rasulullaah ﷺ, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "Certainly. I shall grant each of them a portion. When Allaah gives us again, we shall give them." Hadhrat Usayd (RA) said, "May Allaah grant you the best rewards, O Rasulullaah ﷺ." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "In fact, may Allaah grant the best rewards to you Ansaar. As far as I know, you have always been most chaste and most patient. However, after I die, you shall see that others will be given preference over you."
Hadhrat Usayd (RA) says, "When Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) (became the Khalifah) and was distributing some clothing amongst the people, he sent me a set of clothing, which I regarded to be very little. As I was performing salaah, I noticed a youngster from the Quraysh wearing the same set of clothing which (was so big for him that) he was dragging along. I then recalled the words of Rasulullaah ﷺ: 'After I die, you shall see that others will be given preference over you'. I then said, 'Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ have spoken the truth.' Ibn Adi, Bayhaqi and Ibn Asaakir, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.135). Haakim has also reported the narration in his Mustadrak (Vol.4 Pg.79), narrating from reliable sources as confirmed by himself and by Haythami.
